text:
The first script checks entrypoint identity, record IDs, graph acyclicity and resolution, AST coverage,

theorem prover.

7.2 Companion build

text:
Within the original source archive, build_companion.py regenerates the catalogue from the mathemat-
ical inventory and builds the standalone PDF. The archived runtime builder, build_historical_com
panion.py, reproduces the runtime checks and examples separately from that inventory. These archive
workflows are distinct from the collected monograph build. A TeX installation with the packages
declared in the preamble is required for either PDF build.

text: 7.3 A source change is a new evidence task

lines.text: 7.3 A source change is a new evidence task

text:
If a source statement changes, its source and statement identity change. The KIR, AST, dependency
annotations, operation profile, formal map, and tests must be reviewed for impact. A historical pass
cannot be assigned to a new statement solely because the stable ID stayed the same.

text:
The catalogue is generated from the archived mathematical source and records each statement
and proof hash. The archived runtime payloads retain their own evidence. The additional traditional
models and visual appendix are outside the 108-record inventory. They are not silently counted as extra
machine records.

remains distinct from executed proof machinery.
